messages:
Alex W: Hey @runtime @platform @infra @security — I opened a PR for the quantized batching rollout: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321. Needs quick eyes from runtime (latency), platform (rollout/orchestration), infra (memory/eviction), and security (KMS audit). Target canary Thursday 10:00 PT.

Marina R: Assigned runtime review. Can you paste the perf numbers and how you ran them?

Alex W: TL;DR: +8% throughput on avg, p95 latency +3ms on the biggest model. Baseline/model/RPS in the PR description. Command to repro locally:```bash
# run local perf harness
python tools/perf/run.py --model rr-large-q --seq 1024 --clients 16 --duration 120
```
Also added a micro-benchmark in tools/perf/quantize_bench.py.

Samir: Quick question — how will canary traffic be routed? Do we need a separate route or just a model variant tag? If autoscaler needs different targets we should set those now.

Alex W: Plan is to create a canary variant tag: `quantized-batch-canary`. Suggested rollout YAML snippet in the PR:```yaml
rollout:
  canary:
    tag: quantized-batch-canary
    percent: 5
    duration: 2h
  fallback: route_to: stable
```
Autoscaler unchanged, but platform needs to ensure the canary pool has same GPU families. Samir can you verify pool allocation?

Samir: I can carve out a pool for the canary, but need owners for the canary window. Who will monitor traces?

Alex W: Marina or I can watch tracing + cost. I'll add an observability alert for p95 > baseline+10ms and increased OOMs.

Priya (sec): The PR touches KMS key wrapping code for cached artifacts — I need the exact commit that changes KMS usage and the minimal list of IAM perms. Don't want to block but need quick audit.

Alex W: KMS change is split into commit 7f9c2a3 (link in PR). IAM perms: `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypt`, `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypt`, and `cloudkms.locations.get`. I've added audit logging calls; sample diff is in the PR.

Priya (sec): Ok will scan the commit now. If you can annotate required KMS roles in the PR description that'll speed approval.

InfraBot: CI / checks passed — build, unit tests, integration tests (green). :white_check_mark:

Marina R: I skimmed the perf bench. One ask: please add a short test that verifies KV fallback correctness for short prefixes (edge-case that caused regressions before). Otherwise looks reasonable.

Alex W: Will add the KV fallback unit test in the next patch.

Samir: I can own the canary pool allocation and guardrails. Assigning to CANARY-OWNERS for Thu 10:00 PT.

Alex W: Thanks — tagging runtime+platform reviewers for LGTM. Ping me inline replies or leave :+1:. If we get runtime + platform + infra + sec quick-eyes by EOD tomorrow, I’ll schedule the canary.

Priya (sec): Quick note: I requested a tiny SCA scan on the KMS helper; should be trivial.

Alex W: Great. Summary request: LGTMs from Marina (runtime), Samir (platform), one infra face for memory/eviction, and Priya for security. Thanks all! :pray:
